method: Explanatory bridge only. A/B use equal constant-principal completed H5 cohorts; C uses the same official model head names and due dates but dynamically budgets 90%/5 of preceding account NAV, fractional shares, no fees, no trading constraints. D is the actual Qlib account gross arithmetic return; E subtracts actual fees. C is a deterministic accounting decomposition, not a new selected strategy or official performance result. All stages use annualization 250, risk90 and calendar P&L after A; original official model metrics remain unchanged. Tail cohorts after the official model cutoff are omitted in C, only affecting T/2026/full, not the prespecified D/F slices.
